Build a MultiAssayExperiment Object from SummarizedExperiment Objects

Source: R/build_MAE.R
build_MAE.Rd

Constructs a MultiAssayExperiment (MAE) container integrating multiple omics SummarizedExperiment objects with associated clinical data. Supports the case where different omics assays cover different subsets of samples, as is typical after per-omic train/test splitting and preprocessing.

Usage

build_MAE(omics_list, clinical_data)

Arguments

omics_list

Named list of SummarizedExperiment objects, one per omics layer (e.g. list(mRNA = se_rna, miRNA = se_mirna, CNV = se_cnv, methylation = se_meth)). List names become experiment identifiers in the MAE. Column names of each SE must be set to sample identifiers.

clinical_data

Matrix or data frame of clinical data with variables as rows and samples as columns (the same orientation used by the prepare_* functions). Must contain at least the union of all sample identifiers present across omics_list. Rows "overall_survival" and "status" are expected for survival analysis.

Value

A MultiAssayExperiment object with:

  • experiments: The assays from omics_list.

  • colData: Clinical data as a DataFrame (samples as rows, variables as columns).

  • sampleMap: Auto-generated by MultiAssayExperiment, mapping each assay column to its colData row.

Details

Common sample assumption: multi-omics survival analysis requires the same patients across all layers. When omics_list contains more than one element, build_MAE automatically restricts all assays to their common sample set (intersection). A message reports how many samples are dropped per assay. If the intersection is empty the function stops with an error.

See also

MultiAssayExperiment, prepare_RNA, prepare_methyl, prepare_CNV
